instruction: I want bash to save timestamps with my command history. Look up how to configure HISTTIMEFORMAT in bash and set it up in my .bashrc file to show date and time.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)
